sloka: ते तस्य रूपमालोक्य यथा विष्णोस्त्रिविक्रमे।भयाद्वानरयूथास्ते विद्रवन्ति ततस्ततः ।। ६.७१.८ ।।
transliteration: te tasya rūpamālokya yathā viṣṇostrivikrame।bhayādvānarayūthāste vidravanti tatastataḥ ।। 6.71.8 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara troops, observing his form resembling the Trivikram form assumed by Vishnu, the monkey troops fled here and there in panic.
